applicabilityRationale.GetEnrolledId: js-apis-osAccount-sys.md:5070-5080 section getEnrolledId declares USE_USER_IDM; account_iam_service.cpp:329 checks PERMISSION_USE_USER_IDM before InnerAccountIAMManager::GetEnrolledId.

rationale: Builder-LLM accepts only the getEnrolledId mapping for USE_USER_IDM. IDL GetCredentialInfo is deliberately left uncovered because the corresponding JS getAuthInfo section is a different API name and the mapping is not declared in the same section; the suite reports that method as an application gap instead of mapping it silently.
